dataset: BodyParts3D release 4.0, IS-A Tree, publisher-described polygon reduction rate 99%
attribution: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International
selection: Named left/right cerebral gyri and lobes, both cerebellar components, and paired midbrain, cerebral peduncles, colliculi, pons and medulla. Internal white matter, ventricular spaces, internal capsules and deep nuclei are excluded. No geometry is synthesized.
coordinates: Source whole-body XYZ in millimetres. No translation, rotation, rescaling, mirroring, remeshing, or spatial registration is applied to delivered source coordinates.

exposure_filter.method: Two-sided orthographic z-buffer of all candidate surfaces together in common millimetre coordinates. Keep any original triangle frontmost in any view, or with one of four barycentric probe points at most 0.8 mm behind the depth buffer. Finally include all original triangles sharing a source vertex with a retained face, one pass within each source OBJ. This conservative neighborhood retains adjacent sulcal surfaces; the result is an external display subset, not a watertight tissue mesh.
exposure_filter.direction_recipe: 120 Fibonacci-sphere directions with z=1-(2i+1)/120 and azimuth=i*pi*(3-sqrt(5)), i=0..119, plus the six signed XYZ axes.
exposure_filter.neighbor_expansion: one vertex-sharing face ring per original OBJ

winding_audit.scope: Source-face winding and signed volume checked per unfiltered source OBJ. For signed volume a local origin is used to avoid cancellation at whole-body coordinates. Facet cross product is compared with the mean of the three supplied OBJ corner normals. Original corner order is retained.

geometry.canonical_array_hash_definition: C-order vertices <f8, then faces <u4, then face_labels u1, concatenated without separators.

source_parts.english_name: Anterior part of left superior temporal gyrus
Anterior part of right superior temporal gyrus
Posterior part of left superior temporal gyrus
Posterior part of right superior temporal gyrus

independent_verification: Each of the 79,689 output vertices and all three corner coordinates of each of the 137,062 output faces matched their original source OBJ values exactly, in original corner order and increasing original face order per part. Output labels/ranges, NPZ hash and individual array hashes passed read-back validation.
